'''Faltun Garr''' was a well-respected [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] during the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. After serving as a command officer at various [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] facilities, he was relocated to the [[Coromon Islands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fresia/Legends|Fresia]], where he was placed in charge of an [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] production plant. Many of his Imperial buddies thought the posting on Fresia was something of a demotion, considering the less-than-spectacular working conditions. Faltun, however, didn't seem to mind, and he approached his new assignment with considerable enthusiasm.
